name: Who Do Voodoo
detailed_description:
Who Do Voodoo is a multiplayer card-based social deduction game for 6–16 players.

Who Do Voodoo features a unique card crafting and action system. As players move freely around the map, they gather magical materials to craft three types of cards:

Good Cards to protect and investigate, Bad Cards to sabotage and attack, Fun Cards to prank and confuse.

Cards are played directly on other players in real time, making every round dynamic and unpredictable. Social interaction isn’t just for deception—it’s a strategic tool. Players must read behavior, form alliances, and act with perfect timing.

You play as animated voodoo dolls trapped in a cursed medieval castle, secretly divided into two hidden teams: Good Voodoos and Bad Voodoos. Bluff, deceive, craft magical cards, and outwit your opponents in a high-stakes battle of trust and betrayal.

The game is currently set in a single 3D map with 2D characters, blending handcrafted visuals with tactical gameplay. More maps and content are planned for future updates.

Players can also customize their voodoo doll characters with a variety of skins and cosmetics to express their style and stand out during the chaos.

Will you protect the innocent, spread chaos from the shadows, or simply mess with everyone for fun? In Who Do Voodoo, trust no one—and play your cards right.

Key Features:

  • Team-Based Hidden Roles: Players are secretly divided into two opposing teams: Good Voodoos and Bad Voodoos. Good players aim to uncover traitors, while Bad players work from the shadows to take control.

  • Assassination Ability For Bad Players: As a Bad Voodoo, bluffing isn’t your only weapon—murder is on the menu. Sneak behind enemies and strike when no one’s watching. Just don’t get caught in the act.

  • Card-Based Gameplay: Play three types of cards—Good, Bad, and Fun—to protect teammates, sabotage enemies, or prank everyone. Every action counts.

  • Card-Crafting System: Collect items around the map and combine them to craft powerful or unpredictable cards mid-match. Experiment with secret recipes and shape your deck based on your exploration.

  • Rarity-Based Card System: Not all cards are created equal. Cards come in multiple rarities—common, rare, and legendary—each with unique effects and strategic impact. Powerful cards are harder to craft, but can dramatically turn the tide of the game if used wisely.

  • Strategic Social Deduction: Social interaction is more than deception—it's a core part of strategic play. Observe, manipulate, and outsmart your opponents.

  • Real-Time Player Interaction: Use cards on other players in real time—no menus or delays—just direct, reactive gameplay shaped by timing and intuition.

  • Free-Roam Map: Move freely around the map with no fixed paths or movement restrictions. Positioning and timing are key to your strategy. WASD Movement & Mouse Controls: Navigate the map using WASD and interact with players, cards, and voting systems with intuitive mouse controls.

  • Character Customization: Unlock and equip unique skins and cosmetics to personalize your voodoo doll and express your style.

  • Unique Art Style & Voodoo Aesthetic: A handcrafted mix of 2D animated voodoo dolls and a cursed medieval 3D castle environment gives the game its distinct look and feel.

  • One Map Available (More to Come): The game currently features a single detailed map. More themed maps are planned for future updates.

  • Meeting & Voting System: Call meetings, share suspicions, and vote to banish suspected enemies. Every vote matters.

  • Built-in Voice & Text Chat: Communicate with others through in-game voice and text chat systems, including proximity chat.

  • High Replayability: Randomized roles, shifting alliances, and unpredictable card combinations ensure no two matches play the same.

  • Custom Game Settings: Hosts can tweak match settings to fit their group's playstyle. Adjust card limits, kill cooldowns, meeting durations, and more for casual chaos or competitive mind games.
